identical_effective_input_audit.interpretation: The repeated inputs differ only in requested anchors; the OHLCV arrays and their timestamps are identical. The compatible C labels support using the effective candle array as the input on these controls, but do not identify its generating function.

context_transition_audit.interpretation: At the captured C precision (previous C grouped to 1e-7), an update rule depending only on previous C and exact entering OHLCV is rejected where delta_C differs. The observed data require additional prefix state or another input; they do not distinguish bar count from richer path state because no exact (n, C_previous, entering OHLCV) key repeats.

partition.rule: hold out the 2026-10-12 UTC episode intersecting 18:54-19:30 and all 2026-10-13 cases; time-only, independent of C and absolute price
partition.blindness_note: Locked from target labels in the script, but not a genuinely blind study: the sweep labels are stated in the user request and all labels were previously collected in the package.

short_branch.coefficient_status: 10/183 reproduces the observed n=19,20 ratios but has no independent physical derivation; descriptive candidate only

long_branch_candidate.interpretation: Dimensionless path/volume regression; fixed predictors, OLS fit, no price-specific rules. It is an intentionally simple candidate and fails holdout; its coefficients are not promoted to a discovered law.

named_control_lockbox.rule: exclude exact OHLCV inputs named by C_cruce_doble.json, the 17-step END sweep, and the 15s/1m/2m timeframe file; fit the same fixed OLS feature model on remaining Lite long cases
named_control_lockbox.blindness_note: Exact named control inputs were excluded from fitting. Labels were previously collected and the windows overlap other cases, so this is a label lockbox check, not a human-blind or independent-episode validation.

Character_only_interval_compatibility.note: No numeric Lite residual is assigned to these cases.

predeclared_events.definition: strict new global high/low or radius-1 local high/low confirmed by the entering bar
